7. Using a bandsaw, cut the control panel cover to its correct outside shape.
WARNING Wear safety glasses when drilling the plastic control panel cover. Use care to avoid shattering or chipping the plastic.
8. Tape or glue the template to the plexiglass cover. To start the saber saw cut, drill a 4-inch hole inside the steering wheel hole, the gear shifter cutout, and the button hole.
9. Saw out the large hole for the shifter and the button hole.
10. Drill the four 4-inch holes that will be used to mount the cover to the control panel and the %inch bolt holes to mount the shifter.
11. To prevent injury, carefully deburr all the edges of the plexiglass cover.
12. Install the control panel decal on the control panel. Use a sharp X-ACTO knife to trim the outside edge and to cut out the holes for the controls.
13. Install the cover on the control panel with the four ¥%-inch-long carriage bolts, washers, and nut/washer assemblies.
14. Install the steering wheel pod using the 1/4-20 hardware supplied with it.
15. Install the red button assembly with its “Start” indicator plate and snap-action switch.
16. Install the gear shifter with its #10-24 nut/washer assemblies and %-inch-long carriage bolts. For maintenance and servicing information on the controls, refer to Chapter 2 of this manual.
